107976.nomenclaturename: BRISC and BRCA1 A complex member 2
107976.summary: Enables tumor necrosis factor receptor binding activity. Predicted to be involved in several processes, including cellular response to ionizing radiation; mitotic G2 DNA damage checkpoint signaling; and positive regulation of DNA repair. Predicted to be located in cytosol and nucleus. Predicted to be part of BRCA1-A complex; BRISC complex; and nuclear ubiquitin ligase complex. Is expressed in central nervous system and retina. Orthologous to human BABAM2 (BRISC and BRCA1 A complex member 2). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]
